name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=animation, descriptor=spell_palette_flash_table); reflects the data type ('table') and exact purpose (per-spell palette-flash colour table). No Ghidra address residue in the name. Both readers index it by spell_id, matching the descriptor.
purpose: Per-spell VGA DAC index-0 flash colour table for the spell-cast palette-flash effect; supplies the R/G/B DAC values written to port 0x3C9 during the flash.
logic_summary: 108-byte read-only rodata table = 36 entries x 3 colour components stored as three contiguous 36-byte planes (R @ +0x00, G @ +0x24, B @ +0x48), indexed by spell_id (0x00..0x23). Two readers (fd2_play_spell_palette_flash_with_sfx @0x1D700; fd2_play_figani_animation_loop @0x2B855) each MOVZX byte-load table[id], table[id+0x24], table[id+0x48] and write each to the VGA DAC data port 0x3C9 (RGB), with index-0 DAC write-address set via outp(0x3C8,0). Byte loads with stride 1 and no struct field prove a flat uint8 3-plane layout; values are 6-bit (max 0x3F).
element_semantics: One unsigned 6-bit VGA DAC colour component per byte. Logically 36 (spell) x 3 (R,G,B) laid out plane-major: bytes 0..35 = R for spell 0x00..0x23, 36..71 = G, 72..107 = B.
notes: Verified against both reader disassemblies: 0x1D700 uses [EBX+0x51aad]/[EBX+0x51ad1]/[EBX+0x51af5] (EBX=pattern_id); 0x2B855 uses [ESI+0x51aad]/[ESI+0x51ad1]/[ESI+0x51af5] (ESI=spell_id); +0x24=0x51ad1, +0x48=0x51af5 confirm the 3-plane offsets. Ghidra reports byte[108] len=108 and exactly two DATA(w=false) refs (no writers) -> const confirmed. Ghidra plate was null; created a concise plate consistent with the src comment. src comment block (lines 41-63 of anitab.c) already accurate and final-form -> kept unchanged (no src edit, so staged set is only the shard).
